component.name: Tailscreen Viewer
component.summary: View encrypted peer-to-peer screen shares over Tailscale

description.p: Tailscreen Viewer is the native Linux desktop client for Tailscreen, a low-latency, encrypted peer-to-peer screen sharing tool that runs over Tailscale. It discovers sharers on your tailnet, decodes their H.264 or HEVC video with FFmpeg, and renders it with an OpenGL YUV-to-RGB pipeline inside native GTK4 chrome.
No manual device registration is required: the viewer brings up an ephemeral tsnet node and connects directly to the sharer.
Initial packaging of the native GTK viewer. Placeholder release.
